summary: A 1938 lookout, a 30-ft pole tower with an L-4 cab in the Kaniksu National Forest near Usk, removed in the 1950s; one undated visit saw a possible garage foundation.

facts.design: 30-ft pole tower with an L-4 cab on top
facts.status_note: Removed in the 1950s; the undated visit account describes a possible garage foundation at the top.

access.note: Reached by Forest Service roads from Usk (Kings Lake Road, then FR50). The sources describe no closure or gate.

visit.trail_note: Drive the spur road as far as possible, then walk; about 3/4 mile from the main good gravel road.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: agency, 2012 registration and gone status all match the sources; nothing to correct. Three sources agree on the 1938 build and 1950s removal. The only description of the site today is one undated WillhiteWeb visit account, and no staffing or fire history was found, so the story has no staffing section. The 1950 event year is a placeholder for the decade. Access is marked public because the sources give directions and describe no closure; this is an inference, not a stated status.
